description.subject: A small stuffed doll made of yarn stitches, shaped like a little child with a round white top section, a stitched smile and pink circles on either side of its nose.
description.covering: It wears a red hooded jacket with white trim and white mitten-like hands, blue trousers with red-and-white zigzag cuffs, and yellow-orange booties with red soles, and a gold metal clasp with two gold buttons fastens the jacket at the chest.
description.posture: It stands upright on both feet, facing the camera directly with its hood up and its arms hanging at its sides.
description.setting: It stands on a plain, smooth, off-white surface in front of a blank pale backdrop with no other objects.
description.light: Soft, even, diffuse illumination in a neutral white tone from the front, producing only a faint shadow under the feet.
description.materials: Thick wool-like yarn in red, white, blue and orange-yellow, glossy round plastic pieces for the pupils, thin dark embroidery thread for the smile and lashes, and gold-coloured metal and buttons on the chest.
